selection_basis.rationale: The Algar restoration and wildlife-monitoring programme was established in the Algar caribou herd range to assess seismic-line restoration for caribou habitat and to monitor caribou together with predators and competitors. The focal taxon is therefore chosen from the management objective, not from realized detections.

independent_sources.title: Woodland caribou (Rangifer tarandus caribou): recovery strategy progress report 2012 to 2017
